## Site furniture

Rewritten rather than corrected word by word.

| Where | Was | Now | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Homepage hours heading | Opennig Hours | Opening hours | Spelling. |
| Footer | Javatri 2026.All Rights Reserved | © 2026 Javatri at The Bell and Bottle. All rights reserved. | Missing space, missing symbol, and the trading name was truncated. |
| Brand name, TikTok link | Javitri | Javatri | The site spells the restaurant two different ways. Everything on the new site is "Javatri"; please confirm that is the spelling you want. |
| Homepage "View Specials" button | Linked to the homepage | Removed | It went nowhere. A button that reloads the page you are on is worse than no button. |
| Banqueting "VIEW OUR MENU" button | Linked to the homepage | Links to /menu | It went nowhere. It now goes to the menu. |
| Header "ORDER ONLINE", homepage "ONLINE ORDERING", "View our Menu" | Three buttons, three different broken ordering pages | All order buttons go to /order; "View our menu" goes to /menu | The single most expensive bug on the old site. There is now one ordering route and one menu route. |

## What we deliberately did not change

- **No prices were changed.** Every price on the new site is the price scraped from yours, including
  the ones that look wrong. See `QUESTIONS_FOR_CLIENT.md`.
- **No descriptions were written.** The Indian Street Food dishes have no descriptions on your site,
  so they have none here. Making them up would be putting words in your mouth.
- **No dietary tags were added.** Several dishes sit in vegetarian sections without a vegetarian tag.
  We flagged the contradiction rather than resolving it — see the Dietary questions.
- **No allergens were guessed.** See `ALLERGEN_TODO.md`.
